headline: Master Trust subsidiary starts F&O clearing and settlement services
hook: New revenue stream for Master Trust subsidiary
summary: Master Trust Limited announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Master Capital Services Limited, has commenced clearing and settlement services for Futures and Options trades on both the NSE and BSE. The services became operational through the Custodian Participant Code starting October 15, 2026. This operational expansion allows the subsidiary to handle settlement workflows directly for derivatives clients on the major domestic exchanges. Retail investors tracking the brokerage and financial services sector can note this structural addition to Master Trust's operational capabilities.
why_it_matters: Brokering arm expands institutional and derivatives processing capabilities.
